integrity: The proof conditions on the observed extremes and uses exact finite-population first and second moments for the interior sample. Exhaustive rational enumeration over small populations is supplementary and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes simple random sampling without replacement from a consecutive arithmetic lattice.
It does not extend as stated to arbitrary finite populations, unequal inclusion probabilities, or sampling with replacement.
The most directly relevant 2003 finite-population range article was available only at abstract and metadata level during comparison.
title: Exact variance-on-range regression for sampling without replacement
